why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. It has exactly two checks, one for each expect line. Check 1 runs the TSV vs CSV comparison, and Check 2 greps and reads README.md. npm test and the plain-CSV regression appear only under "Advisory (not pass/fail)", so they are not counted as checks and cannot change the verdict. That means there is no third check. Check 1's PASS/FAIL conditions cover only exit codes, the cmp result and the JSON shape. Check 2's cover only whether README mentions --tsv and says what it does. Neither one requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass. The builder brief does ask the builder to run npm test, but that is not a verifier PASS/FAIL condition. Neither must_not item is broken.
